about: Text over a gradient, or over a plain colour with a texture laid on it, is measured from a picture of the page instead of being skipped in silence, also further down a page that asks for smooth scrolling. Words are not measured against a badge inside them, or against an outline in their own ink.

must: text over a picture or gradient is
"Grey words on a grey gradient."; measured from a picture of the page
"Words on a sheet that a stain darkens."; measured from a picture of the page
piece(s) of text over a picture or gradient were measured from a picture of the page and pass
must_not: Dark words on a pale gradient."; measured
